backup.title: Fayil ɗin ajiya
backup.meta: Yana yin cikakken kwafin ajiyar uwar garken Leafen, tare da bayanan shiga da fayiloli.
backup.help: Ana adana ajiya na kwanaki 7. Ana gudanar da dawo da ajiya daga CLI zuwa tushen bayanan Leafen mara komai, ta amfani da fayil ɗin da aka sauke da SHA-256 da aka nuna.

backup.failedNoSpace: Fayil ɗin ajiya bai sami sarari a faifai ba. Saki ɗan sarari, sannan sake gwadawa.
backup.failedBusy: Wani ajiya ko dawo da ajiya yana gudana, don haka ba a yi fayil ɗin ajiya ba. Sake gwadawa idan ya ƙare.
backup.withoutScreen: Dawo da bayanai daga wannan fayil
backup.restoreWay_server: A cikin babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da wannan fayil, umarnin da ke ƙasa zai mayar da shi cikin sabon babban fayil ɗin bayanai, leafen-restored. Da zarar ya bayar da rahoton “restored”, dakatar da wannan sabar kuma fara ta a kan wannan babban fayil (serve --dir=leafen-restored).
backup.restoreWay_container: Saka wannan fayil a cikin babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da compose.yaml, dakatar da sabar da docker compose down sannan cire volume ɗin bayananta (…_leafen-data a cikin docker volume ls). Sannan, a cikin wannan babban fayil, mayar da shi da umarnin da ke ƙasa kuma fara ta da docker compose up -d.
backup.restoreWay_app: Ana mayar da wannan fayil a kwamfutar da ba a taɓa buɗe manhajar Leafen ba. Shigar da manhajar sannan, kafin buɗe ta, gudanar da umarnin da ke ƙasa a cikin terminal a cikin babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da wannan fayil, sannan buɗe manhajar.
backup.restoreWay_phone: Wayar hannu ba ta da terminal don gudanar da umarni, don haka ana mayar da wannan fayil a kwamfuta. Matsar da shi zuwa kwamfutar da ke da Leafen, kuma Ajiya → “Mayarwa daga wannan fayil” na wancan Leafen zai ba da umarnin da za a gudanar a can. Don matsar da Leafen na wannan wayar gaba ɗaya zuwa wata sabar, yi amfani da Mayarwa da matsawa → “Matsar da wannan sabar”, wanda ba ya buƙatar fayil.

updates.title: Sigar
updates.dockerWay: Wannan uwar garke tana gudana a cikin Docker. Idan an shigar da ita da Docker Compose, sabunta ta a cikin babban fayil ɗin da compose.yaml yake: docker compose pull, sannan docker compose up -d. A kan NAS, Container Manager ko Portainer suna yin haka ta hanyar sake jan image ɗin da sake ƙirƙirar container ɗin (Build na aiki, sake jan da sake tura tarin). Bayanai, saituna da haɗin kai suna nan, kuma uwar garken tana adana bayanan da suka gabata yayin da take sabuntawa.

updates.notChecked: Ba a duba sabuwar siga ba tukuna
updates.checkHelp: Sau ɗaya kowace rana, yana tambaya ko bayanan sakin da aka sa hannu (sabuwar siga, alamar tsaro, jerin masu tallafawa) sun canza, kuma idan sun canza yana ɗauko su. Ba a aika bayanan wurin aiki, asusu, ko amfani. Tallafin kuɗi yana tallafa wa ci gaban Leafen.
updates.checkEnvironmentOff: An kashe dubawa ta hanyar mabambancin muhallin uwar garke LEAFEN_UPDATE_CHECK=off, don haka ana amfani da bayanan da ke cikin sakin kawai.
updates.appAutoUpdateHelp: Yana zazzage sabuwar siga a bayan fage, yana tabbatar da wanda ya yi ta, sannan yana musanya idan an sake kunna manhajar. Ana ajiye kwafin bayanan, kuma sigar da ta kasa tashi tana komawa ga wadda ta gabata.

protection.title: Kariyar ajiya
protection.codeShownOnce: Ana nuna wannan lambar ceto yanzu kawai. Kwafa ta, buga ta ko rubuta ta, kuma ajiye ta a wani wuri da ba wannan uwar garken ba.
protection.codeHelp: Da wannan lambar, ana iya buɗe ajiyar a kowane uwar garke koda an rasa wannan. Idan babu lambar ko kalmar sirri, babu wanda zai iya buɗe su — har da mu.
protection.passwordHelp: Aƙalla haruffa 12, kuma ba wadda aka saba ba; gajeriyar jimla tana aiki sosai. Ba za a iya dawo da kalmar sirrin da aka manta ba.
protection.required: Ajiyar da za ta fita daga wannan kwamfuta — S3, WebDAV ko babban fayil ɗin daidaitawa na girgije — tana buƙatar lambar ceto ko kalmar sirri tukuna.
protection.requiredDevice: Ajiyar da ke cikin babban fayil ɗin da aka zaɓa a waya tana buƙatar lambar ceto ko kalmar sirri da farko.
protection.help: Ana ɓoye bayanai, fayiloli da jerukan ajiyar. Ko lambar ceto ko kalmar sirri tana buɗe su, kuma canza ɗaya ba ya shafar ɗayan ko ajiyar da suka gabata.
protection.offHelp: Ajiyar da aka ajiye a wannan kwamfuta na iya zama ba a ɓoye ba. Ƙirƙira lambar ceto don ɓoye su da kuma yin ajiya a wajen wannan kwamfuta.
protection.offHelpDevice: Ƙirƙira lambar ceto don ɓoye ajiyoyin da kuma ajiye su a cikin babban fayil ɗin da aka zaɓa a waya.
protection.passwordMismatch: Kalmomin sirri biyu ba su daidaita ba.
protection.passwordChanged: An canza kalmar sirrin ajiya. Ajiyar da ta gabata ma tana buɗewa da ita.
protection.codeReplaced: An ajiye sabuwar lambar ceto; tsohuwar ba ta ƙara buɗe kwafin ajiya ba.
protection.weak: Zaɓi kalmar sirrin kwafin ajiya mai tsayi: aƙalla haruffa 12, ba wadda ta zama ruwan dare ba. Jumla gajera tana aiki da kyau.
protection.last: Kwafin ajiya na buƙatar lambar ceto ko kalmar sirri. Ƙara ɗayan kafin a cire wannan.
protection.openHelp: An ɓoye waɗannan kwafin ajiya da wata sabar ko wani maɓalli na baya. Lambar cetonsu ko kalmar sirrinsu na buɗe su a nan. Idan na wata sabar ne, wannan sabar ba za ta rubuta kwafin ajiya a nan ba har sai an yi mayar da bayanai daga gare su ko an danna “Rubuta a nan” a cikin Kwafin ajiya.
protection.openerWrong: Wannan lambar ceto ko kalmar sirri ba ta buɗe waɗannan kwafin ajiya ba.

restore.meta: Yana maye gurbin abin da sabar ke da shi yanzu da kwafin ajiya. Ana ajiye abin da take da shi yanzu na kwanaki 7, ko har zuwa kwafin ajiya na gaba, don a iya soke mayar da bayanai.

restore.confirmBody: Duk abin da ke wannan uwar garke zai koma yadda yake a {{time}}. Abubuwan da aka canza bayan haka za su kasance kawai a cikin ajiyar bayanan yanzu, wanda za a iya mayar da shi na kwana 7 ko har sai an yi sabon kwafin ajiya. Wataƙila mutane za su sake shiga.

restore.restartManual: Hakan zai faru lokacin da za a sake kunna uwar garken ko manhaja: rufe ta sannan a sake buɗe ta.
restore.restarting: Uwar garken tana sake farawa. Wannan shafin zai sake lodawa idan ta dawo.
restore.waiting: Za a maido da kwafin ajiya {{name}} lokacin da za a sake kunna uwar garken ko manhaja.
restore.undoWaiting: Abin da uwar garken ke da shi kafin a maido da ajiya zai dawo lokacin da za a sake kunna uwar garken ko manhaja.

restore.failed: Mayar da ajiyar {{name}} bai iya ƙarewa ba saboda uwar garken ko manhajar sun fara a {{time}}: ba a mayar da komai ba, kuma Leafen yana ci gaba da abin da yake da shi a baya.
restore.undoFailed: Soke mayar da ajiyar bai iya ƙarewa ba saboda uwar garken ko manhajar sun fara aiki a {{time}}: Leafen yana ci gaba da abin da yake da shi.
restore.undoBody: Uwar garken za ta koma abin da take da shi kafin mayar da kwafin. Abin da aka canza bayan haka zai ɓace. Wataƙila mutane za su sake shiga.
restore.snapshotUnavailable: Ba za a iya buɗe wannan kwafin ajiya ba, ko kuma bai ƙunshi abin da jerinsa ya ce ba.
restore.earlierLeafen: Wannan ajiyar ta fito daga wani Leafen na baya, wanda wannan sigar ba ta buɗe shi ba, don haka wannan uwar garken tana riƙe da bayananta. Maimako, a matsa wuraren aikinta ɗaya bayan ɗaya: a ƙirƙiri sabon wurin aiki a nan kuma a fara shi da “Matsa daga wata uwar garke”, sannan a liƙa lambarsa cikin saitunan wurin aiki na Leafen na baya, ƙarƙashin Matsa wannan wurin aiki.
restore.newerLeafen: Wannan ajiyar ta fito daga wani Leafen sabo fiye da wannan uwar garken. A fara sabunta wannan uwar garken, sannan a mayar da ita.
restore.alreadyWaiting: Akwai aikin maido da ajiya da ke jira har sai an sake kunna uwar garken.
restore.busy: Ana yin kwafin ajiya ko maido da ajiya. Sake gwadawa idan an gama.

restore.restartFailed: Ba a iya sake kunna Leafen ba. Rufe manhajar sannan a sake buɗe ta.
restore.restartInApp: Zai ƙare lokacin da manhajar ta sake kunna uwar garkenta: danna “Sake farawa yanzu” na gaba, ko rufe manhajar sannan a sake buɗe ta.

restore.replicaConfirmBody: Za a maye gurbin bayanan wannan uwar garken da {{name}}, tun daga canjinsa na ƙarshe. Uwar garken da ta rubuta kwafin za ta daina karɓar canje-canje da zarar ta lura, sannan wannan uwar garken za ta ci gaba daga kwafin.
restore.pageMeta: Maido da uwar garken zuwa wani kwafin ajiya, ko matsar da ita gaba ɗaya zuwa wata uwar garke.
restore.needsBackup: Don maido da bayanai daga kwafin ajiya, da farko a kunna kwafin ajiya da aka tsara. Kwafin ajiyar da aka ajiye a can za su bayyana a nan.
restore.withoutScreen: Maido da ajiya ba tare da wannan shafi ba
restore.folderWay_server: Umarnin da ke ƙasa yana mayar da ajiya daga babban fayil ɗin ajiya cikin sabon babban fayil ɗin bayanai, leafen-restored. Da zarar ya nuna “restored”, a dakatar da wannan uwar garken sannan a sake tada ta a kan wannan babban fayil ɗin (serve --dir=leafen-restored).
restore.folderWay_container: Dakatar da uwar garken da docker compose down sannan a cire data volume ɗin uwar garken (…_leafen-data a cikin docker volume ls). Sannan, a cikin babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da compose.yaml, a mayar da ajiya da umarnin da ke ƙasa sannan a sake tada uwar garken da docker compose up -d.
restore.folderWay_app: Ana mayar da ajiya a kan kwamfutar da ba a taɓa buɗe manhajar Leafen a cikinta ba. Shigar da manhajar kuma, kafin a buɗe ta, a gudanar da umarnin da ke ƙasa a cikin terminal, sannan a buɗe manhajar.
restore.folderWay_phone: Waya ba ta da terminal don gudanar da umarni, don haka a mayar da ajiya a wannan allo, wanda aka zaɓa daga jerin da ke sama. Idan uwar garken manhajar ta kasa tashi, tagan manhajar za ta ba da zaɓin mayar da ajiyar da aka tsara ta ƙarshe; a wata kwamfuta, allon farko na sabuwar Leafen yana mayar da ajiya daga wurin ajiya ɗaya da “Mayar da ita daga ajiya”.
restore.folderNewest: Umarnin yana ambaton ajiyar da ta fi sabo; don wata, saka sunanta daga Leafen backups/snapshots na babban fayil ɗin ajiya a wurinsa.
restore.folderDownload: Don ajiyoyin da ke kan uwar garken WebDAV ko a cikin S3, sai a fara sauke dukan babban fayil ɗin Leafen backups sannan a saka inda yake a cikin umarnin.
restore.folderDownloadContainer: Don ajiyoyin da ke kan uwar garken WebDAV ko a cikin S3, sai a fara sauke dukan babban fayil ɗin Leafen backups cikin babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da compose.yaml.
restore.folderSealed: An ɓoye ajiyoyin: ba da fayil ɗin da kalmar sirri ke a layinsa na farko ga --password-file, ko wanda ke ɗauke da lambar ceto ga --recovery-code-file.
restore.folderSealedContainer: An ɓoye ajiyoyin: saka fayil ɗin da kalmar sirri ke a layinsa na farko a cikin babban fayil ɗin da ke ɗauke da compose.yaml sannan a ba shi ga --password-file, ko wanda ke ɗauke da lambar ceto ga --recovery-code-file.

tunnel.title: Shiga daga waje
tunnel.meta: Bari mutane da wakilai a wajen cibiyar sadarwarku (kamar ChatGPT ko Claude a yanar gizo) su isa wannan uwar garke ba tare da domain, tura port ko takardar shaida ba. Masu gudanarwa ne kaɗai za su iya kunnawa.
tunnel.localOnly: A wannan adireshin, Leafen na wannan kwamfutar yana aiki kamar kowace uwar garke: na'urorin da kuka ƙara, mutanen da kuka gayyata da wakilai suna haɗuwa a can. Ana iya isa gare shi ne kawai yayin da wannan kwamfutar ke kunne kuma ba ta barci.
tunnel.cloudflare: Tunnel mai sauri ko tunnel ɗin Cloudflare naku yana wuce da zirga-zirga ta sabis ɗin Cloudflare naku na kyauta, inda ake warware ɓoyewar.
tunnel.tailscaleDescription: Shiga da asusun Tailscale ɗinka kuma uwar garke za ta sami tabbataccen adireshin https na jama'a. Tsarin kyauta na amfani ne na sirri, ba na kasuwanci ba, don haka kamfani yana buƙatar tsarin Tailscale mai biya.
tunnel.tailscaleSetup: Babu abin da za a girka. Idan ba ka da asusu, ƙirƙiri ɗaya a shafin shiga na Tailscale.
tunnel.tailscalePlan: Tsarin kyauta na Tailscale na amfani ne na mutum, ba na kasuwanci ba; kamfani yana buƙatar tsarin Tailscale mai biya na kansa.
tunnel.ownAddress: Yi amfani da domain na kaina
tunnel.ownAddressDescription: Adireshin https da reverse proxy naku ko tura port suka riga suka isar da shi ga wannan uwar garke. Leafen ba ya buɗe tunnel kuma yana amfani da shi a ko'ina.
tunnel.ownAddressFact: Haɗi suna isa proxy naku ko wannan uwar garke kai tsaye; ana warware ɓoyewar a duk inda https ɗinku ya ƙare.
tunnel.ownAddressTLS: (wannan uwar garke tana ba da HTTPS da kanta a port {{port}})
tunnel.forwarding: Tsohon adireshin {{from}} yana turawa zuwa {{to}} har zuwa {{date}}.
tunnel.forwardingProxy: Yana aiki ne kawai yayin da proxy naku ko tunnel ɗin Cloudflare ke ci gaba da tura shi zuwa wannan uwar garke.
tunnel.forwardingSignedOut: Tsohon adireshin {{from}} ba ya turawa yanzu: an fita daga na'urar Tailscale ɗinsa. Don sake tura shi, canza hanyar zuwa Tailscale, shiga, sannan koma zuwa adireshin yanzu.
tunnel.forwardingPaused: Da aka kashe shiga daga waje, adireshin da ya gabata {{from}} ba ya aikawa yanzu; idan an sake kunna, yana aikawa har zuwa {{date}}.
tunnel.forwardingExtends: Muddin yana karɓar buƙatu, yana zama kwana 30 bayan na ƙarshe, har zuwa shekara ɗaya daga canjin.
tunnel.forwardingInUse: Har yanzu ana amfani da shi ta {{uses}}, na ƙarshe {{date}}.
tunnel.tailscaleFact: Haɗe-haɗen sadarwa suna wucewa ta Tailscale amma ana warware su a wannan uwar garken. Idan takardar shaida ta wannan adireshin da wannan uwar garken bai nemi ba ta bayyana, uwar garken zai same ta a tarihin takardun shaida na jama'a, ya sanar da kai kuma ya kashe adireshin.
tunnel.tailscaleLogin: Shiga Tailscale domin Leafen ya sami adireshinsa. Kowane browser yana aiki, haka ma waya; Leafen zai lura idan ka gama.
tunnel.tailscaleAllow: Ka riga ka shiga. A ƙarshe, danna “Buɗe Tailscale” ka ba da izinin adireshin Leafen a wurin; wannan allo zai ci gaba da kansa da zarar an ba da izini.
tunnel.tailscaleRenamed: Tailscale ya ba wa wannan uwar garken wani suna dabam domin wata na'ura mai suna “{{name}}” tana nan a cikin Tailscale ɗinka. Cire waccan tsohuwar na'ura a Tailscale sannan ka sake kunna wannan don samun irin wannan adireshin.
tunnel.tailscalePublishing: Tailscale yana saka adireshin Leafen a intanet. A karo na farko yana iya ɗaukar minti kaɗan.
tunnel.tailscaleTailnetName: Sashin bayan aya ta farko shi ne sunan cibiyar sadarwar Tailscale ɗinka. Idan kana son wani, canza shi a saitunan DNS na Tailscale kafin ka raba hanyoyin haɗi.
tunnel.certificateAlert: Takardar shaida ta wannan adireshin da wannan uwar garken bai nemi ba ta bayyana — {{issuer}} ne ya bayar a ranar {{date}}. Wani zai iya amfani da ita don warware haɗe-haɗen da Tailscale ke miƙawa, saboda haka an kashe adireshin jama'a.
tunnel.certificateAlertClear: Nawa ne — sake kunna adireshin jama'a
tunnel.certificateWatchChecked: An yi duba na ƙarshe a tarihin takardun shaida na jama'a don wannan adireshin: {{date}}.
tunnel.certificateWatchUnverified: Ba a iya duba tarihin takardun shaida na jama'a yanzu ba; za a sake gwadawa daga baya. Duba na ƙarshe: {{date}}.
tunnel.configured: Wannan sabar tana amfani da adireshin da ke cikin saitunan farawa (LEAFEN_PUBLIC_URL), {{address}}. Zaɓi wata hanya a sama kuma sabar za ta yi amfani da adireshinta maimakon.

tunnel.setByStart: Saitunan farawa na wannan uwar garken suna bayar da adireshinsa (LEAFEN_PUBLIC_URL). Don amfani da wani, cire shi daga saitunan farawa sannan ka sake farawa uwar garken.
tunnel.offDescription: Ana iya isa gare shi daga wannan kwamfuta ko cibiyar sadarwa kawai.
tunnel.offReached: Leafen ba ya buɗe wata hanya da kansa, amma an buɗe wannan uwar garken daga waje a {{origin}}: proxy ko port forward na router a gabansa ne ke ba da ita.

failureKinds.ownAddress: HTTPS a adireshin ku na kansa baya aiki: ba a iya karanta takardar shaidarsa ba, ko ba a iya ɗaukar tasharsa ba. Leafen yana ci gaba da ƙoƙari; Bayanai sun faɗi dalilin.

replication.behind: Canje-canje ba sa isa ga kwafin.
replication.ownedElsewhere: Kwafin wata uwar garke yana wannan wuri. Mayar da bayanai daga gare shi a “Mayarwa da motsawa”, ko ka zaɓi wani wuri.
replication.notice: Kwafi mai ci gaba ya tsaya.
replication.moved: Bayanan wannan uwar garke sun koma wata uwar garke da aka sake dawo da ita daga kwafin. Canje-canjen da ake yi a nan ba a adana su.
replication.movedTo: Bayanan wannan uwar garke sun koma {{address}}, wadda aka sake dawo da ita daga kwafin. Canje-canjen da ake yi a nan ba a adana su.
replication.keepApart: Yi amfani da wannan uwar garke kaɗai
replication.keepApartHelp: Za ta sake karɓar canje-canje a matsayin uwar garke daban, tare da kashe kwafi, don haka ba za ta taɓa rubuta zuwa kwafin wata uwar garke ba. Canje-canjen da aka yi a wata uwar garke ba sa zuwa nan.
replication.missing: Kwafin da wannan uwar garke ta rubuta ba ya wurin ajiye kuma (wurin ya zama fanko, ko an haɗa wani a wurin). Kashe kwafin sannan ka sake kunnawa don sake farawa.
replication.needsBackup: Kwafi mai ci gaba yana zuwa inda ajiyar da aka tsara ke zuwa. Ka fara kunna su.

standby.title: Sabar mai jira
standby.newCodeMade: An yi sabuwar lamba. Tsofaffin lambobin ba sa aiki kuma.
standby.addHelp: Uwar garke ta biyu ta Leafen tana bin wannan ta hanyar kwafin, kuma tana karɓe aiki kai tsaye idan wannan ta daina amsawa. Tana buƙatar siga ɗaya ko sabuwa. Da adireshin Tailscale, uwar garken da ta karɓi aiki tana amsawa a wannan adireshin. Da naka domain, ka nuna domain ɗin ga uwar garken da ta karɓi aiki; da ramin sauri, adireshin yana canzawa bayan karɓe aiki.
standby.codeHelp: Liƙa shi a wata uwar garke a ƙarƙashin Saituna → Uwar garke → Uwar garke mai jira → Zama uwar garke mai jira. Yana ɗauke da maɓallan wurin ajiye da kalmar sirri: ba da shi ga mai gudanar da wannan uwar garke kawai. Yin sabuwar lamba yana hana tsofaffin lambobin da ba a yi amfani da su ba. Idan lamba ta je inda bai kamata ba, canza maɓallan wurin ajiye a can kuma shigar da sabbin maɓallan a wurin ajiye a nan.
standby.primaryHelp: Idan wannan uwar garke ta kasa isa wurin ajiye na daƙiƙa 10, za ta daina karɓar canje-canje har sai ta iya, domin uwar garke mai jira ta karɓi aiki lafiya.
standby.paused: Wannan uwar garke ba ta iya isa wurin ajiye, don haka ba ta karɓar canje-canje a yanzu; uwar garke mai jira na iya karɓe aiki.
standby.gone: Ya tafi (babu sigina sama da minti 5)
standby.following: Wannan uwar garke tana bin {{address}} kuma tana karɓe aiki idan ta daina amsawa.
standby.followingPlace: Wannan uwar garke tana bin babbar uwar garke ta hanyar wurin ajiye, kuma tana karɓe aiki idan babbar ta daina amsawa.
standby.takingOver: Ana karɓar aiki… za a sake kunna sabar nan ba da jimawa ba
standby.auto: Karɓar aiki kai tsaye idan babban sabar bai amsa ba na daƙiƙa 30
standby.takeOverQuestion: A mai da wannan sabar babban sabar yanzu?
standby.takeOverWarning: Wannan sabar zai karɓi aiki daga kwafin kuma ya sake farawa a matsayin babban sabar. Idan tsohon babban sabar yana aiki har yanzu, zai daina karɓar canje-canje.
standby.help: Don sabunta sabobin biyu da ɗan tsayawa kaɗan: da farko a sabunta wannan sabar mai jira, a karɓi aiki, sannan a sabunta tsohon babban sabar kuma a ƙara shi a matsayin sabon sabar mai jira.
standby.joinHelp: Bayanan wannan sabar ana maye gurbinsu da na babban sabar lokacin da ya karɓi aiki.
standby.tookOverPrimary: An karɓi aiki daga babban sabar a {{time}}
standby.codeInvalid: Ba za a iya amfani da wannan lambar haɗi ba. Ƙirƙiri sabuwa a babban sabar sannan a liƙa ta.
standby.notFresh: Wannan sabar yana yin kwafin bayanansa; da farko a kashe hakan.
standby.versionOlder: Wannan sabar ya tsufa fiye da babban sabar; da farko a sabunta shi.
standby.replicaUnavailable: Kwafin babban sabar ba ya a wannan wurin, ko kalmar sirri ba ta buɗe shi.
standby.earlierLeafen: Bayanan uwar garken farko na wani Leafen na baya ne, wanda wannan sigar ba ta buɗe shi ba, don haka wannan mai jiran aiki ba ya karɓar aiki. Maimako, a matsa wuraren aikin uwar garken farko ɗaya bayan ɗaya zuwa wata uwar garke a wannan sigar: a wancan uwar garken, a ƙirƙiri sabon wurin aiki kuma a fara shi da “Matsa daga wata uwar garke”, sannan a liƙa lambarsa cikin saitunan wurin aiki na uwar garken farko, ƙarƙashin Matsa wannan wurin aiki.

direct.unreachable: Ba a iya isa ba — an tantance ta wurin ajiya kawai
direct.none: Babu adireshi — an tantance ta wurin ajiya kawai

standby.placeSlow: Mai jira yana buƙatar wurin ajiya da sabobin biyu za su iya samu a lokaci ɗaya, kamar S3 ko faifan da aka raba. Babban fayil ɗin daidaita cloud yana nuna canje-canje a makare.
standby.meta: Idan wannan sabar ya tsaya, wani sabar zai karɓi aiki daga 'yan daƙiƙa kaɗan da suka wuce.
standby.addNeedsReplication: Don samun sabar ajiya ga wannan sabar, da farko ku kunna ci gaba da kwafi a sama. Na ƙasa don mai da wannan sabar ta zama sabar ajiya ta wata sabar.

remoteChoice.title: A buɗe Leafen daga ko'ina?
remoteChoice.configuredTitle: Wannan sabar tana amfani da adireshin daga saitunan farawarta
remoteChoice.configuredBody: Hanyoyin haɗi, gayyata da haɗin wakilai suna amfani da wannan adireshin. Zaɓi wata hanya kuma za a yi amfani da adireshinta maimakon.
remoteChoice.body: Don wayarku, abokan aikinku da manhajojin AI na intanet su shiga Leafen, yana buƙatar adireshin intanet nasa.
remoteChoice.phone: Leafen na waya yana tsayawa idan an rufe manhajar, don haka ba ya buɗe adireshin jama'a. Don isa gare shi daga waje, ku matsar da shi zuwa kwamfuta ko sabar da ke ci gaba da kunne.
remoteChoice.tailscaleSteps: Shiga da asusun Tailscale kyauta ka ba da izini, kuma ka gama. Babu abin da za a girka.
remoteChoice.tailscaleFact: Haɗe-haɗe suna wucewa ta Tailscale amma ana warware su a wannan sabar.
remoteChoice.domain: Yi amfani da domain na kaina
remoteChoice.domainBody: Adireshin da kuke da shi, tunnel ɗin Cloudflare naku, ko port forwarding.
remoteChoice.domainRecommended: An ba da shawara don sabar kamfani da sabar gida
remoteChoice.directHint: Don sabar kamfani, ko ɗaya da ke da hanyar shiga daga waje (port forwarding ko domain naku), ana ba da shawarar <way>Yi amfani da domain na</way>.
remoteChoice.quick: Gwada shi na ɗan lokaci, ba tare da asusu ba
remoteChoice.quickBody: Tunnel ɗin Cloudflare mai sauri: adireshin yana canzawa duk lokacin da aka kunna shi, wanda ke karya haɗin wakilai da hanyoyin haɗi da aka raba.
remoteChoice.laterBody: Ku bar shi yadda yake; za a sake tambayar ku idan wani abu ya buƙaci adireshi.
remoteChoice.signInQRAlt: Lambar QR na adireshin shiga Tailscale
remoteChoice.allowQRAlt: Lambar QR ta shafin Tailscale da ke ba da izinin adireshin jama'a
remoteChoice.quickFailing: Tunnel ɗin bai buɗe ba tukuna, kuma yana ci gaba da ƙoƙari. Idan wannan cibiyar sadarwa ta toshe shi, ku koma baya ku zaɓi wata hanya.
remoteChoice.tailscaleFailing: Tailscale bai buɗe adireshin ba tukuna, kuma yana ci gaba da ƙoƙari. Idan ya ci gaba da kasa, koma baya, sannan zaɓi wata hanya.
remoteChoice.addressQR: Sikan da wayarka don shiga a wurin
remoteChoice.addressQRAlt: Lambar QR ta adireshin jama'a na wannan sabar
remoteChoice.quickChanges: Adireshin tunnel mai sauri yana canzawa duk lokacin da aka kunna shi.
remoteChoice.closedBody: Wannan sabar ba ta iya isa intanet, don haka ana buɗe ta a adireshin kamfani da takardar shaidar kamfanin.
remoteChoice.ownBody: Wannan sabar na iya isa intanet amma ba ta iya amfani da Tailscale ({{reason}}). Ku saita adireshin ku tare da wakili.
remoteChoice.handToAgentBody: Yana kwafa umarni mai ɗauke da abin da wannan sabar ya gano. Wakilin yana bayyana zaɓuɓɓukan kuma yana tambaya kafin kowane canji da ya shafi sadarwa, tsaro ko kuɗi.
remoteChoice.handToAgentClosed: Yana kwafa umarni don saita shi a adireshin kamfani da takardar shaidar kamfanin, don ku yi aiki da shi tare da ƙungiyar IT ɗin ku.
remoteChoice.handToAgentCopied: An kwafa. Manna shi cikin wakilin ku. Wannan taga yana gano lokacin da aka saita adireshin.
remoteChoice.doItYourselfBody: Jagorar: port forwarding, IPv6, VPS tare da frp, da domain.
remoteChoice.doItYourselfClosed: Jagorar: adireshin kamfani, takardar shaidarsa, da reverse proxy.
remoteChoice.tailscaleUnusable: Ba za a iya amfani da shi a nan ba: {{reason}}.

check.ok: An duba: takardar shaidar {{names}}, har zuwa {{date}}. Buɗe ta a wayarku.
check.dns: An duba: har yanzu ba a iya warware sunan wannan adireshin ba. Duba rikodin DNS ɗinsa.
check.unreachable: An duba: har yanzu babu abin da ke amsa HTTPS a wannan adireshin. Duba proxy, port forwarding ko tacewar wuta.
check.name: An duba: takardar shaidar da ke amsa a wannan adireshin ta wani suna ne.
check.expired: An duba: takardar shaidar da ke amsa a wannan adireshin ta ƙare.
check.untrusted: An duba: wannan kwamfutar ba ta amince da mai bayar da takardar shaidar ba, kuma na'urorin da ba su amince da ita suna ƙin ta.

prompt.closedIntro: Ka taimake ni in ba sabar Leafen ta adireshin da mutanen kamfanina za su iya buɗewa. Leafen ta auna cewa wannan sabar ba ta isa intanet ba, don haka tana cikin hanyar sadarwa mai rufi: yi amfani da adireshin kamfani da takardar shaidar kamfanin.
prompt.ownIntro: Ka taimake ni in ba sabar Leafen ta adireshin da ke aiki daga waje. Ba za ta iya amfani da Tailscale a nan ba, don haka mu ƙirƙira namu, tare.
prompt.factsTitle: Abin da Leafen ta auna a wannan sabar:
prompt.factPortMapping: - Rawuta tana buɗe port da kanta: NAT-PMP {{natpmp}}, UPnP {{upnp}}
prompt.closedWays: Zaɓuɓɓukan da za a yi la'akari da su: sunan DNS na ciki na wannan sabar, takardar shaidar kamfani ko CA ta ciki, da reverse proxy da ƙungiyar IT ke gudanarwa tuni, ko Leafen da kanta ke ba da HTTPS da wannan takardar shaidar.
prompt.ownWays: Zaɓuɓɓukan da za a yi la'akari da su: tura port a rawuta (ko buɗe port ta atomatik da ke sama), adireshin IPv6 na duniya, ƙaramin VPS da frp, sabis ɗin tunnel da ke aiki a inda nake, da sunan yanki. Ka auna kuɗin kowanne, abin da yake fallasa, da tsawon lokacin da zai daɗe.
prompt.consult: Ka yi aiki tare da ni: gaya mini abin da ka gano da hanyoyin da ke buɗe, tare da fa'idodi da illolinsu, ka bar ni in zaɓa. Ka tambaye ni kafin kowane canji da ya shafi hanyar sadarwa, tsaro ko kuɗi (saitunan rawuta ko firewall, shigar da shiri, sayan VPS ko yanki), kuma ka yi shi ne kawai bayan na yarda.
prompt.safety: Ka'idoji: HTTPS kawai. Kada ka taɓa buɗe shafukan gudanarwa na Leafen ba tare da shiga ba. Kada ka kashe saitunan tsaro.
prompt.finish: A ƙarshe, kada ka gyara fayiloli da hannu: ka kira kayan aikin MCP na Leafen leafen_remote_access tare da action set_address da adireshin https, da takardar shaidar, maɓalli da port idan wannan sabar ya kamata ta karɓi HTTPS da kanta. Yana aiki ne kawai a haɗin mai gudanarwa. Leafen tana duba adireshin kuma tana nuna mini QR don buɗe shi a wayata.
prompt.connectFirst: Da farko ka haɗa zuwa Leafen ta a matsayin mai gudanarwarta (Saituna → Fasaloli → Wakilai na ba da rubutun), domin ka iya amfani da kayan aikinta.
prompt.companyIntro: Ka taimake ni in ba sabar Leafen ta adireshin da mutanen kamfanina za su iya buɗewa. Na kamfani ne, don haka yi amfani da yankin kamfanin da takardar shaidarsa maimakon adireshin Tailscale na sirri; ka tattauna da ni inda zai dace a hanyar sadarwar kamfanin.

remoteChoice.companyBody: Wannan ya yi kama da sabar kamfani (yankin imel na kamfani ko yankin ƙungiya), don haka yana buɗewa da adireshin kamfanin da takardar shaidarsa da farko. Shirin kyauta na Tailscale ba na kasuwanci ba ne, kuma hanyoyin sadarwar kamfani sukan toshe shi.
remoteChoice.tailscaleAtCompany: Shirin sa na kyauta na amfanin sirri ne; kamfani yana buƙatar shirin biya, kuma wasu hanyoyin sadarwar kamfani suna toshe shi.
remoteChoice.skipCost: Idan ka tsallake wannan, wayoyi da manhajojin AI a intanet ba za su iya shiga ba. Za ka iya kunna shi daga baya a Saituna.

serverMove.title: Matsar zuwa wata sabar
serverMove.meta: Komai yana ƙaura: mutane, shafuka, tarihi, fayiloli, saituna da adireshin nesa.
serverMove.confirmQuestion: A matsar da wannan sabar zuwa sabuwar sabar?
serverMove.outHelp: A sabuwar sabar, buɗe Saiti → Sabar → Mayarwa da matsarwa → Matsar da sabar zuwa nan, sannan liƙa lambar ta a nan. Sabuwar sabar na buƙatar wannan sigar ko sabuwa.
serverMove.warning: Daga yanzu babu wanda zai iya yin canje-canje a nan, kuma adireshin nesa zai koma sabuwar sabar. Wannan sabar za ta kasance mai karantawa kawai kuma za ta nuna zuwa can; “Yi amfani da wannan sabar ita kaɗai” zai mayar da ita.
serverMove.copying: Ana aika komai zuwa {{address}}… A wannan lokacin babu wanda zai iya yin canje-canje a nan.
serverMove.finishing: {{address}} yana tabbatar da bayanan kuma yana mayar da su; zai sake farawa da bayanan wannan sabar.
serverMove.movedOut: Bayanan wannan sabar sun koma {{address}}. Ba ta ƙara karɓar canje-canje a nan.
serverMove.failed: Matsarwar ta tsaya, kuma wannan sabar ta sake karɓar canje-canje kamar da. Don sake gwadawa, sake liƙa wannan lambar. Idan ba a karɓe ta ba, ƙirƙiri sabuwa a sabuwar sabar.
serverMove.readFailed: Ba a iya karanta yanayin ƙaura ba.
serverMove.inEarlierLeafen: Bayanan wata uwar garken na wani Leafen na baya ne, wanda wannan sigar ba ta karɓa, don haka ba a matsar da komai ba. Maimako, a matsa wuraren aikinta ɗaya bayan ɗaya: a ƙirƙiri sabon wurin aiki a nan kuma a fara shi da “Matsa daga wata uwar garke”, sannan a liƙa lambarsa cikin saitunan wurin aiki na wancan uwar garken, ƙarƙashin Matsa wannan wurin aiki.
serverMove.inRefused: Ba a iya buɗe bayanan wata uwar garken a nan ba, don haka ba a matsar da komai ba.
serverMove.inHelp: Yana ƙirƙirar lambar da za ta yi aiki na awa ɗaya. An maye gurbin komai a wannan sabar da na ɗayar sabar; ana ajiye bayanan yanzu a gefe na kwanaki 7.
serverMove.inNotEmpty: Wasu mutane suna amfani da wannan sabar. Ana matsar da cikakkiyar sabar ne kawai zuwa sabar da babu wanda ke amfani da ita tukuna; a maimakon haka, matsar da wurin aiki.
serverMove.inCodeLabel: Lambar sabar da ke zuwa nan
serverMove.inCodeHelp: Liƙa ta a tsohuwar sabar a ƙarƙashin Saiti → Sabar → Mayarwa da matsarwa → Matsar da wannan sabar, kafin {{time}}. Tana ba da damar waccan sabar kaɗai ta haɗa a nan: kar a raba ta.
serverMove.inStoppedIncomplete: An daina karɓa: abin da aka aiko bai zo duka ba, ko kuma bai dace da jerinsa ba.
serverMove.inStoppedBusy: An daina karɓa: ana yin ajiya ko mayar da ajiya a wannan uwar garken.
serverMove.inStoppedFailed: An daina karɓa: wannan uwar garken ba ta iya haɗa bayanan da suka zo ba. A duba tarihin uwar garken.
serverMove.inStoppedNext: Ba a canza komai a wannan uwar garken ba. Don sake gwadawa, a sake liƙa wannan lambar a tsohuwar uwar garken; don dainawa, a soke.
serverMove.restoring: Ana mayar da bayanan; wannan sabar za ta sake farawa da su nan ba da daɗewa ba.
serverMove.restoringManual: An mayar da su. Fita daga Leafen kuma sake buɗe shi don farawa da bayanan da aka matsa.
serverMove.movedIn: Wannan sabar ta karɓi bayanan {{address}} a {{time}}.
serverMove.movedInHelp: Ku canza manhajojinku da wayoyinku zuwa adireshin wannan sabar, sannan ku ba wa wakilan waje rubutun haɗin da ke ƙarƙashin Saiti → Fasaloli → Wakilai. Ku duba saitunan ajiya: ƙila babu babban fayil ɗin ajiya a wannan kwamfutar.
serverMove.codeInvalid: Sabuwar sabar ba ta karɓar wannan lambar ba. Wataƙila ta ƙare, ko sabuwar sabar ta sake farawa kuma ba ta da ita yanzu. Ƙirƙiri wata sabuwa a sabuwar sabar.
serverMove.versionOlder: Sabuwar sabar ta fi wannan tsufa. Sabunta ta tukuna.
serverMove.unreachable: Wannan sabar ba ta iya isa sabuwar sabar a adireshin da ke cikin lambar ba.
serverMove.busy: Wannan sabar tana ƙaura, maido da bayanai ko yin ajiya a yanzu. Sake gwadawa idan an gama.
serverMove.sameServer: Wannan lambar ta wannan sabar ce. Liƙa ta a kan sabar da za ta ƙaura zuwa nan.
